# Zoubeyr Sahraoui

> Creative strategist and direct-response copywriter based in Tunis, Tunisia.
> Works with e-commerce brands on creative strategy, Meta Ads campaigns and
> direct-response ad copy. Available for remote work worldwide.

## Summary

Zoubeyr Sahraoui turns customer insight into advertising concepts, hooks and
scripts for e-commerce brands. His method runs in a fixed order: understand the
customer, find the angle, write the creative, then read the numbers (ROAS, CPA,
hold rate) to decide what gets scaled, rewritten or dropped.

He has founded and run his own direct-to-consumer brand including its ad budget,
and has run communication for an events agency with a community of 400,000.

## Capabilities

- Brand strategy: brand positioning, product positioning, creative strategy, audience insight
- Paid media: Meta Ads, campaign planning, performance optimisation, ROAS and CPA analysis
- Content and community: community management, content direction, ad copywriting, creative concepts
- Partnerships: sponsorship strategy, brand collaborations, campaign execution, results reporting

## Selected work

- SaZo (2024) — Founder & Growth Marketer. Direct-to-consumer matching jewellery
  for couples. Over $10,000 ad spend managed, 5,000+ purchases, CPA $1.5, ROAS 3:1.
- VIP Events & Pub (2019) — Community Manager. Tunisian events agency.
  400k+ community growth, 100+ events promoted, 50+ sponsorships, 200+ events covered.
- Al-Sojood — Creative Strategist. Prayer chair brand focused on comfort and
  support. Over $10,000 ad spend managed, 7,000+ purchases, CPA $1.7, ROAS 2:1.
